system.description:
Seamanship covers all of the basic knowledge and skills, short of actual sailing, necessary to survive on board a boat or ship: stowing, cleaning, mending shipboard paraphernalia and water discipline.

Obstacles: Rowboat or skiff, Ob 1. Longboat, Ob 2. Junk, Ob 3. Caravel, Ob 4. Carrack, Ob 5. Felucca, Ob 6. Treasure ship, Ob 7.

Skill Type: Seafaring. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 294
